settings.title: Settings
settings.visibilityHelp: Fixed: always visible. Smart: hides when a window covers it. Peek: appears at the screen edge. In fullscreen apps every mode shows only when the pointer reaches the screen edge.
update.title: Updates
update.error.check_failed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
update.error.download_failed: The update could not be downloaded.
update.error.verify_failed: The update could not be verified and was not installed.
update.error.no_update: No update is available any more.
update.error.busy: An update is already in progress.
settings.replaceTaskbarHelp: Hides the Windows taskbar and uses the dock instead. It always comes back when you quit MacDows or turn this off.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.startTint: Paint the Windows Start menu in the theme color
appearance.startTintHelp: Start, Search and quick settings are Windows's own. While MacDows runs, Start and Search take this color; the accent color of your apps and the window title bars stay your own. Your colors come back when MacDows closes. Off, only the light or dark look follows the theme.
settings.about.license: MacDows is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
settings.showPinnedHelp: Shows the apps pinned to the Windows taskbar at the start of the dock. A running one keeps its place and gets a dot.
settings.hiddenPinned: Pinned apps hidden in the dock
settings.hiddenPinnedHelp: {n} pinned app(s) were removed in the dock but Windows would not unpin them, so they stay on the Windows taskbar list.
settings.showDrivesHelp: Shows your disks and USB drives in the dock after the pinned apps. Click one to open it.
settings.winNumberHelp: Win+1 to Win+9 start or focus the pinned apps of the dock in order; Win+Shift+number opens a new window. Needs a keyboard hook; turn it off if your antivirus complains.
settings.previewsHelp: Hover a running app in the dock to see small pictures of its windows. Click one to bring it forward, or close it from there.
island.fullscreenHelp: Edge: the island appears when the pointer reaches the top of the screen. Never: it stays hidden while a fullscreen app is in front.
island.lastScreen: At least one screen must stay on
island.click.smart: The player while music plays, otherwise quick settings
island.nav.hoverPlayerHelp: While something is playing or paused, resting the pointer on the island opens the player with its controls.
island.nav.middle: The middle button opens calendar and timer
island.nav.rememberHelp: When the pointer comes back, the island shows the screen it was on.
settings.showDesktopHelp: Adds a button at the end of the dock that jumps to the desktop. Press it again to bring your windows back.
